title: Tutorials
description: Documentation for the nnsight Python library

segments.html:
Comprehensive tutorials covering core concepts and research techniques.

Getting Started

  • Walkthrough - Complete introduction to nnsight
  • Chat Templates - Working with chat-formatted models
  • Remote Access - Getting started with NDIF

Migrating

  • From TransformerLens - Port a TransformerLens script: the hook-name/module-path table, and the weight-processing conventions that make a correct port produce different numbers

Causal Tracing

  • Causal Models Intro - Introduction to causal modeling
  • Activation Patching - Patching activations to trace information flow
  • Attribution Patching - Gradient-based attribution methods
  • Causal Mediation I - Causal mediation analysis part 1
  • Causal Mediation II - Causal mediation analysis part 2
  • DAS - Distributed Alignment Search

Probing

  • Logit Lens - Interpreting intermediate representations
  • Diffusion Lens - Probing diffusion models
  • Concept Erasure - Removing a linear subspace inside the forward pass, and measuring what it costs

Attention

  • Attention Patterns and Per-Head Detection - Reading the attention probability matrix with .source, and scoring every head for induction, previous-token and sink behaviour

Circuits

  • Attribution Graphs - Replace the MLPs with a cross-layer transcoder and trace which features caused an output

Architectures

  • MoE Routing - Reading a mixture-of-experts router, and the two ablations that quietly measure the wrong thing
  • State-Space Models - Reading and writing the recurrent state of a Mamba-style model, where there is no KV cache

Engineering

  • Dataset-Scale Activation Caching - Running a corpus to disk: throughput, memory, resumability, and the anchor that says the cache still matches the model

Steering

  • Evaluating SAEs - Given a pretrained sparse autoencoder, is it any good?
  • Dictionary Learning - Learning interpretable feature dictionaries
  • LoRA Tutorial - Low-rank adaptation with nnsight

Vision

  • Cross-Attention Ablation - Localising where a prompt attaches in Stable Diffusion
